subject: general
question:
In the following letter-cluster pairs, the first letter-cluster is related to the second letter-cluster following a certain logic. Study the pairs carefully, and select the pair from the given alternatives, which follows the same logic as the following pairs.

LUN ∶ PXP 

WXP ∶ AAR

4d:
solution: According to the English alphabets and their positional values: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] The pattern followed in the given clusters is: **First alphabet is increased to 4 positional values. Second alphabet is increased to 3 positional values. Third alphabet is increased to 2 positional values.**
